title: Hearty Bitter Irish Lamb Skillet
description: A low-carb friendly Irish dish featuring lamb, chives, and bitter flavors, perfect for a dinner show-off, this recipe is sure to shatter expectations with its rich flavors.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bitter ale, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated broiler and cook for 10 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to desired doneness.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the chopped chives.
Serve the lamb and sauce hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
